name: Projected Interpolation Degree / co-VC Dimension (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite classes.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $\mathrm{coVC}(\mathcal S_n)=n$ while $\mathrm{intdeg}^p(\mathcal S_n)=1$.
proof: The canonical Full-Cube and Singleton value calculations provide the two opposite unbounded gaps.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Projected Interpolation Degree and co-VC Dimension of the Full Cube and Singletons.
